title: Over to you: pay at Casa Halcy
lines: Casa Halcy's payment page is open in the browser window. You pay Casa Halcy directly; Halcy never sees your card or your bank code.
Can be cancelled, on the hotel's conditions.
In that window: enter your card, read and accept the hotel's booking conditions, and confirm with your bank.
Your bank should ask you to approve €0.00 to Casa Halcy, or to save your card as a guarantee. If it shows anything else, stop.
The hotel holds the room for about 1 more minutes.
Come back here when you are done.

text: Still with me? The hotel holds the room for about 1 more minutes.
About 1 minutes left on the hotel's hold. If you have not entered your bank code yet, stop now; I'd rather start over than have you pay for a room the hotel has released.

said: I didn't hear back in time, so I've stopped. I can't see a booking on Casa Halcy's site. I can't see your card or your bank, so I can't tell whether anything was approved. If you confirmed a payment or entered a bank code, check with Casa Halcy before trying again.
